inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A rose gold teleport hoop lies flat in a scorched landing ring like a hearth, plum starlight rising out of it like flames, a small caged sun floating above it, under a dome of thin glowing star map lines with tiny planets, lighting the stone floor warm.", "style_description": {"aesthetics": "the glowing heart of a bare camp on a high plateau above the clouds, the warm centre the camp gathers around, one coherent pixel art scene", "lighting": "cold morning sun from the upper left with cool blue shadows, and warm golden light from the small sun pooling on the stone floor round the hoop", "medium": "pixel art", "art_style": "crisp clustered pixel art at one pixel size, flat colour planes with hard pixel edges, a few hue shifted shades per material, the same pixel art as the floor around it", "color_palette": ["#261B30", "#34242D", "#452A34", "#443230", "#4B3832", "#4E3533", "#534144", "#7D5D57", "#C29B7B", "#C0A88B", "#CDAE7E", "#D2AB7D", "#CDB084", "#D4B586", "#D2BD92", "#DAC59D"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "the flat tan stone floor of a bare high plateau, a dark scorched landing ring in the middle of it, in bright cold morning light", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [420, 378, 730, 615], "desc": "a rose gold teleport hoop lying flat on the scorched ground like a hearth, plum starlight rising out of it like flames", "color_palette": ["#C59A7A", "#CCAF83", "#F9C06F", "#58384E", "#8E4271"]}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [190, 446, 400, 546], "desc": "a small bright sun held in a cage of thin rose gold bars, floating above the hoop", "color_palette": ["#FFF6DC", "#FFE29A", "#FFB85C", "#CCAF83", "#F9C06F"]}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [120, 278, 700, 715], "desc": "a dome of thin glowing star map lines with tiny planets over the hoop", "color_palette": ["#B2BACD", "#B9C6D7", "#CCE2E8", "#8E4271", "#FFB85C"]}]}}
